request: Make four matching product photographs for a warm editorial campaign. Vary only angle and props. Review every result.
base_prompt: A matte skincare bottle on a cream studio surface for an editorial campaign.

rules.instruction: Use cream #F4EFE6 for the background and charcoal #252525 for accents. No saturated accent colors. Hex values are targets, not proof of exact pixel color.
Soft window light from the upper left; warm neutral grading and soft contact shadows. No dramatic rim light or neon.
Matte surfaces, restrained editorial photography, natural material detail. No glossy CGI, floating elements, or decorative gradients.
No people, extra text, watermarks, or invented logos.
